_comment_secrets: Connection strings and Jwt:Key are intentionally empty here. Supply them via dotnet user-secrets in development and environment variables in production. Never commit a real credential to this file.

Otp._comment_source: Passed to USP_I_OTP and USP_S_Officer_ValidateOTP. Confirm the agreed value with BBMP before going live.

_comment_sms: All Sms values are credentials or DLT registration details. Supply them via user-secrets or environment variables; leave them empty here. Sender must be set to SmsGateway for them to be read.
_comment_network: KnownProxies/KnownNetworks must name BBMP reverse proxy before X-Forwarded-For is believed. Empty means the headers are ignored and the OTP rate limiter counts the proxy as one client - safe, but not protecting anyone.
_comment_media: RootPath must sit outside the application directory so a redeploy cannot remove a ward evidence. Store becomes the object-store driver once BBMP supply its endpoint.
